title: Trouble at a colored dance and the poisoned bottle
summary: Men threatened him over a woman's lie, and she later left him a poisoned half pint he avoided.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: They were pretty rough in the channel, huh?

Oh, yeah, man. It was rough. Well, the Negroes were rough too, partner. Yeah, they was tough too. Dang, man. They had a girl there. They got broke out after me there. And she's going with a waking fellow there. You know what I mean? I didn't know, Dick. And there were about four of them that were going to kill me when we get in that night. We had played at St. Elizabeth Hall up there at Napoleon Avenue. And I'm coming in that night and they're all in the corner. But lucky Johnson was in front of me and Dave and them. And me and Dave and them were back there talking, running out of my mouth, half drunk, you know. So when Ernest got there, they asked him where was I? I said, we're going to kill her that time of tonight. I said, for what? The man said, if you want to be this man's old lady. So Ernest said, oh, no, man. Well, I wouldn't. She's after me, but I had never bothered with her. So they got that thing up and found out she was lying. She's just after me, but she was lying. See, when he got after, she was lying. So I got to be good friends to them. They never bothered me after that.
Yeah, colored dance. You know what she did after that dance? What's that? That woman told me she was going to bring me half a pint to the cooperators and all. And they had poison in it.

But Lord is good. Something keep on telling me. I put that thing inside my chair right there. And something just kept a whooping me. Don't you touch that bottle. And doggone little fellow took that bottle. Some boy drinks a lot. Say he'd drink anything. Tuck that bottle and went to find out what was wrong with it. And he said, yeah, it was pure poison. Something just hit me up before I drank it. He didn't drink me. He found out what it was. See?
